snippet.title: Call of the Elder Gods | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Call of the Elder Gods is coming to PC, Switch 2, PS5 and Xbox Series S|X on 12th May, and is available day one on Xbox Game Pass. 

Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

This is the official release date trailer for Call of the Elder Gods.

Check out the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174380/Call_of_the_Elder_Gods/
